data.name: Elkanah
data.gender_notes: Elkanah is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Elkanah in the Hebrew Bible is a man of God who had two wives, Hannah and Peninnah. He showed kindness and generosity to his wives, and Hannah, who was childless, prayed to the Lord for a son, whom she named Samuel. Elkanah's name signifies God's grace and generosity towards his people. The name Elkanah carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Elkanah usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Elkanah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elkanah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אלקנה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים קנה לי - אלוהים קנח אותי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלקנה הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'אלוהים קנה לי' או 'אלוהים קנח אותי'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'אל' - קיצור של אלוהים, ו'קנה' - פועל שמשמעותו 'לרכוש' או 'לקנות'. השם אלקנה מופיע בתנ'ך ככינויו של אביה של הנביאה שמואל.

in_greek.name: Ἐλκανά
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἐλκανά (Elkanah) σημαίνει 'ο Θεός κατέστησεν ἐμέ' (ο Θεός κτήσατό με) ἤ 'Θεός γέγονεν ἐμοί'. Ὁ ὄνομασμος τούτου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ βασίζεται εἰς τὴν ἑβραϊκὴν λέξιν 'אלקנה' (Elkanah), ᾧ περιέχει τὴν ἰδέαν τῆς κτήσεως ὑπό τοῦ Θεοῦ.

in_latin.name: Elkanah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elkanah significat 'Deus possedit me' vel 'Deus adquisivit mihi'. Etymologia hebraica nominis Elkanah, quae componitur ex 'El' (Deus) et 'kanah' (possedit), revelat notionem proprietatis divinae.

in_english.name: Elkanah
in_english.long_meaning: Elkanah is a Hebrew name meaning 'God has possessed' or 'acquired by God'. Derived from 'El' (God) and 'kanah' (to possess), the name signifies divine ownership. Elkanah appears in the Bible as the father of the prophet Samuel (1 Samuel 1:1). The name conveys spiritual significance, implying a deep connection to God.

data.cultural_impact: Elkanah is a Hebrew name derived from the root words "El," meaning God, and "kanah," meaning acquire, posses, or "my God." Historically, it was a name given to boys in ancient Israel, but its usage has extended beyond that context. In the diaspora, it became a popular name among Jewish communities as well as Christians.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Elkanah carries significant spiritual meaning as it underscores the idea of God's grace and generosity. In the biblical narrative, Elkanah is portrayed as a man of God who showed kindness and generosity to his wives, reflecting God's love and care for his people. Moreover, Elkanah's son, Samuel, would become a significant prophet in Israel's history and one of the last Judges. The name thus underscores the enduring connection between God's goodness, His people, and His provision.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Elkanah means "God is gracious" or "God has been gracious." This name reflects the faith and trust in God's abundant blessings and kindness towards His people.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Elkanah is a son of Jeroham, the son of Eli, who was a priest in Shiloh. The name Elkanah carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Elkanah is mentioned in the Hebrew Bible, in the book of Samuel.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Elkanah continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Mary Elkanah from London, United Kingdom embodies the meaning of Elkanah - "God's grace". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
